⚙️ Basics

Automation

In simple words

Using machines or software to do tasks by themselves, with little or no human help.

Using machines or software to do tasks automatically, with little or no human help. AI makes it possible to automate more and more complex tasks.

Example. Self-checkout machines, automatic email replies and factory robots that build cars are all examples of automation.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 5: AI in Everyday Life

Related words

  • RobotA machine that can sense its surroundings and move or act in the physical world.
  • AlgorithmA clear, step-by-step set of instructions for solving a problem.
  • Artificial intelligence (AI)Computer systems that can do tasks that usually need human intelligence.
